notes.title: SwingStar VR 1.5 Update, 5 new levels, moving clouds, animated helmet hands.
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27030670/db0875599589b25e43020a9229a580bc6f00fa5b.png[/img]
Get the new patch which includes 5 new thrilling levels, and a new power up block type the moving cloud. We fixed the bug where opening a secret doors would erase stars on that level. We redid the graphics in the canyon levels. The kid also got a new animated helmet hand, so fancy.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27030670/aeb8104a207512d27c5882734345495eda8c2a77.png[/img]
If you are enjoying SwingStar VR and want future updates with exciting levels and fun features, you can help support the game development by leaving a review. A review helps us promote the game a lets people know the game is worth playing.

Keep on Swinging.


List of changes to this version
- 5 new thrilling levels
- a new power up block type the Cloud Mover 
- We fixed the bug where opening a secret doors would erase stars on that level. 
- We redid the graphics in the canyon levels. 
- The kid also got a new animated helmet hand, so fancy.
- Update the "Awesome" ending animation.
- Fixed bug were the menu would not be clickable through world objects.
- Fix minor frame freeze on first time swing on bell
- Main menu has a cleaner look
- Replaced boring touch controller hands with new animated cartoon hands. 
- Install file size footprint has been reduced
